(Published by Authority)PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
NOTICE OF POLL
Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262)
NOTICE UNDER SECTION 38(1)
ELECTION OF MAYOR, DEPUTY MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF THE COLOMBO MUNICIPAL COUNCIL

NOTICE is hereby given under Section 38(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that the above election iscontested and that a poll will be taken between 7.00 a. m. and 4.00 p. m. on 10.02.2018 and that :-

(a) the names of the candidates in the first nomination paper as indicated by the candidates of each RecognizedPolitical Party and Independent Group for Election as Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Members of the abovementioned Local Authority, the numbers and names of the respective wards and the names of candidatesin the second nomination paper to be returned ; and the approved election symbol allotted to each partyand Independent Group, the distinguishing number alloted to each such Independent group ; and
(b) the situation of the polling station or stations and the particular polling stations reserved for femalevoters in the polling districts in the above mentioned electoral area
are specified in the schedule below.

2. The order in which the name of each Recognized Political Party and Independent Group appearing in the Schedulebelow is the same order in which these particulars will be printed on the ballot paper.

W. M. C. KUMUDUNEE WIJEKURUPPUReturning Officer,Colombo Municipal Council,Assistant Returning Officer,Colombo Administrative Districtfor Returning Officer.Colombo District Election Office,26th day of December, 2017.

NOTICE is hereby given under Section 38(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance that the above election iscontested and that a poll will be taken between 7.00 a. m. and 4.00 p. m. on 10.02.2018 and that :-

are specified in the schedule below.
